_meta.provenance: hand-labeled by human review of cluster_review.json (top occupations + top tasks per cluster); no LLM / API calls
_meta.labeling_rule: 19 top-level ops, plain-English noun names, no "and" connectives. Each op is defined with (a) a one-line plain statement, (b) its input and output, (c) explicit contrasts against adjacent ops. Every op is verified to be distinct.
